text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I have a secret mission today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For one reason or another, I've never
been able
to give her a proper send-off
before a race—not
even for our goal
races.
choice_data_list: （マーチャンの入場を絶対に見送る！）

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But this time, I'm going to keep my eyes
locked
on her. If she leaves her seat, I'll
stick right by her
side. With renewed
determination, I raise my gaze
to focus
on my target, and—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's already gone.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm feeling rough, tough, and ready to
go. I think
that... yes, I might just be in
perfect condition.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Is something wrong? Why do you look so

flustered?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: You want to... see me off?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right. I forgot how much of a

workaholic you are.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
How do I explain this to her? She really
seems to
have no idea how I feel.
choice_data_list: いや、仕事熱心というより……

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: For the things that matter?
choice_data_list: 君の一大事には、隣にいたいんだ
貴方の一大事には、隣にいたいの

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Even though they only matter to me?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: If you say so...
choice_data_list: マーチャンの、一大事だからだ
マーチャンの、一大事だからだよ

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Now you're even more of a mystery to
me than
before.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
One step forward, one step back. It's
quite a
conundrum.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Oh well... I have to go now.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'll forget about this for the time being.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I will. See you after.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she walks away, Aston Machan looks
over her
shoulder at me several times,
until...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Go get 'em.
I will.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Go get 'em...
I will...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She heads out to the Sprinters Stakes.
